A learning-focused writing review

Strengthen writing you have already created.

Cougar Word Lab helps you notice possible spelling, grammar, punctuation, sentence-clarity, and word-choice concerns. It explains suggestions so you can make informed editing decisions.

✓ What it can doIdentify localized concerns and explain possible corrections.
✕ What it will not doWrite assignments, add ideas, build arguments, or create research and citations.
🛡️

Designed around authorship

  • No blank-page writing or chat prompt
  • No paragraph, thesis, evidence, or conclusion generation
  • Each suggested change is visible
  • You accept or reject every suggestion
  • Your document is not retained by this file
